CART RULES
» Keep lid closed.
» Recyclables must be clean, empty, &
dry.
» Do not bag recyclables, except for
shredded paper. If you must bag them,
only clear bags are acceptable.
» Carts must be out by 6:30am & at least
4 feet from obstructions.
